documentation.content:
Filesystem usage on the VM is high.

Why this is a priority rather than a nuisance: production, staging, Postgres, Redis and MinIO all share ONE host and ONE disk. A full disk does not degrade gracefully — Postgres stops accepting writes, which takes the application down and can stop audit rows being written.

**First response:** check container log sizes first (`docker ps -s`), then MinIO data and Postgres growth. Container logs are capped at 10m x 5 per service, so if they are the cause something is logging in a loop.

There are no backups yet (F-004), so a disk-full event that corrupts data is currently unrecoverable. Treat accordingly.
